act1.text1_1: In the beginning, humans gathered around the fire.
act1.text1_2: It gave them warmth, light, and community.
act1.text2_2: Zeus looked upon their fire with contempt.
act1.text3_1: And with a single breath, he extinguished it.
act1.text3_2: Knowledge, freedom and warmth were gone.
act1.text4_1: Humanity sat in darkness once more.
act1.text4_2: Waiting for someone to light a new fire.

gap1.text: Yet in the deepest darkness, a spark remained...

act2.prom_2: Ready to challenge the gods and take back the fire.
act2.olimp1: He refused to accept the darkness.
act2.olimp2: He snuck into the palace of the gods.
act2.olimp3: And he seized the sacred flame.
act2.olimp4_1: He raced down the mountain to return the fire to humanity.
act2.olimp4_2: Warmth, light, and hope returned to human hearts.
act2.rekindle_2: And with fire in their hands, humanity began to build.
act2.civ_1: From embers to empire, civilization rose.
act2.civ_2: The gift of fire sparked science, architecture, and sovereignty.

twain.quote: “History does not repeat itself, but it does rhyme.”
twain.author: Attributed to Mark Twain

act3.text1: Before screens claimed our sight, the world was tangible.
act3.text2: The early web was a triumph of human agency.
act3.text3: Then we drew the blinds to see the glow of screens.
act3.text4: Then came platforms that profit from our time.
act3.text5: Addictive fast food and cheap dopamine.
act3.text7: Planned obsolescence built into our devices.
act3.text9: A flood of cheap, disposable junk.

act4.text3: A single titan is not enough.
act4.text4_bottom: And there are many of us.
act4.text6: This time we are the titan.

dignity.title: AN ALTERNATIVE IS POSSIBLE.
dignity.sentence1: “In the realm of ends, everything has either a PRICE or a DIGNITY.
dignity.sentence2: What has a price can be replaced by something else as its equivalent;
dignity.sentence3: what on the other hand is above all price and therefore admits of no equivalent has a dignity.”
dignity.author: Immanuel Kant, Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals (1785)

act5.intro_sub:
Every tool we build is meant to serve one principle:
protecting human dignity.
act5.law_quote: “All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights.”
act5.law_source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 1 (1948)
act5.call_to_action: Human dignity is written into the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and into the constitutions of more than 160 countries, over 80% of UN member states. We want these words to be supported by the design of the technology we use every day as well.

suveria.title: We start with your private digital space
suveria.text: Like a cosy room of your own: you walk in, close the door and calmly sort out your affairs, thoughts and plans. We are designing Suveria so that no one watches you there, and digital intelligence helps only when you want it to.
suveria.highlight: Every protection claim we make must be verifiable. Where we do not meet it yet, we say so plainly.

meta.title: Novus Ignis · An internet built on human dignity
meta.description: The Novus Ignis Foundation is co-creating an alternative internet whose highest value is human dignity. Suveria: a private digital space. Omniforum: a shared space for conversation and decisions.

hub.title:
An internet built
on human dignity
hub.subtitle: We begin by co-creating an alternative internet whose highest value is human dignity and the needs for privacy and freedom that follow from it. From these values come two directions of work: Suveria, a private digital space for each person, and Omniforum, a shared public space where people can meet, understand each other and act together.
hub.docs_sub: The statute is the law of the foundation. The manifesto is our commitment to people: what we want to do and why. The whitepapers show how it works technically and where the limits are.
hub.docs_note: We develop the documents as our knowledge and experience grow, keeping a history of changes.

manifest.desc: What we want to do and why: dignity, privacy, shared understanding, sustaining services and handing over power.

suveria.desc: What we protect and against what, the path from device to model, a dated cost calculation and acceptance tests.

omniforum.desc: Issues, idea cards, argument maps, living documents and rules for shared decisions.

fundacja.desc: Paying for actual use, the budget, work and roles, the register of benefits and handing over the founder's powers.

benchmark.desc: Training materials and a benchmark: how to check whether digital intelligence really helps people.

statut.desc: The law of the foundation, every version of the statute and a register of changes with reasons.

hub.roles_title:
No one can carry this alone.
We are all Prometheus.
hub.roles_desc: If you find even one value in the manifesto that is close to you, and you see a place where you can contribute, we invite you to co-create Novus Ignis.
hub.roles_hint: Click an area to write to us with a ready subject line.
hub.roles_note: Just as important is the experience of people who can tell us what they face every day and what would really help them.
hub.join_title: Let's start with a piece of the world we can improve together.
hub.join_text: Write to salve@novusignis.org and tell us what matters to you and what you would like to bring: a skill, a question, an idea or an experience.
hub.join_disclaimer: We do not collect addresses through forms. Your message goes straight to our inbox.

today.title: Where we are today
today.works_text: The foundation is registered, and the manifesto and whitepapers are published. Every sentence in the documents has a working “I have a comment” button.
today.project_text: Omniforum has a first prototype under construction, and Suveria is a project.
today.hypothesis_text: The cost calculation is a hypothesis to be tested: even a small group may get more digital intelligence for every dollar than from closed services, with privacy that can be checked.
today.vision_text: Independent management by digital intelligence and the further pillars are a vision.
today.note: We tell apart what works from a project, a hypothesis and a vision, because we promise nothing we cannot justify.

spaces.title: First pillar: two spaces
spaces.suveria_text: Suveria is meant to be a private space on the internet where a person talks with digital intelligence, works on their own materials and returns to earlier thoughts, as in their own home behind closed doors. Today Suveria is our best route to private work with digital intelligence, not a goal in itself.
spaces.omniforum_text: Omniforum is meant to be a place where anyone can speak on any subject and be heard. A simple question, “so you want to say this and that, do I understand you correctly?”, changes the tone of a conversation on both sides. The whole technical layer of Omniforum is meant to support exactly that reflex.

help.title: How you can help
help.m5_text: Read the introduction to the manifesto and mark a sentence that is unclear or that you disagree with, then click “I have a comment”.
help.m5_model: If you read us through a model, ask it also about our weakest points and send us what it found.
help.h1_text: Look through the whitepaper from your own field: security and infrastructure (Suveria), law and finance (foundation rules), research (materials and benchmark), conversation and decisions (Omniforum).
help.more_text: Help build the first versions: the roles and what we need are described on the Join page.
help.money_text: The foundation accepts donations by bank transfer in zlotys, euros and dollars. We show every payment in the public register with a date, an amount and a short description; we name donors only if they themselves wish it. A donation gives no votes, no influence on decisions and no right to promotion. Transfer details and rules
